items.q: The stock rose, pulled back, then rose again. Click the low of the pullback (the lowest price between 2026-03-09 and 2026-03-18).
items.explain: The pullback ran from 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-18 and its lowest low was 100.29. A pullback low that holds is the support level traders watch.

items.q: Three big candles run up from the range. Click the bottom edge of the gap: the high of the first of the three (2026-03-16).
items.explain: The 2026-03-16 candle ends at a high of 51.68. The 2026-03-18 candle never trades below 54.31, so no trades happened between 51.68 and 54.31. That empty band is the gap.

items.q: What was the lowest low in this sideways range (the first 30 bars)?
items.explain: The lowest low in the first 30 bars was 48.20. The highest high was 51.64.

items.q: The first six 5-minute bars (09:30 to 09:55) set the opening range, 199.71 to 200.88. What did price do after that?
choices: Broke above the range and kept rising
Broke below the range and kept falling
Stayed inside the range all morning
items.explain: From 10:00 price pushed above 200.88 and reached 203.80 by 12:25. That is an opening range breakout to the upside.
